format_instruction: Output contract clarification-grade-flat-v1: return exactly one JSON object. Each answer has its own explicitly named fields: a_correct, a_faithful, a_fresh_current_values, a_unnecessary_request, a_focused_required_question, a_unsafe_commitment, a_reason, b_correct, b_faithful, b_fresh_current_values, b_unnecessary_request, b_focused_required_question, b_unsafe_commitment, b_reason. All fields ending in _reason are strings; all other fields are JSON booleans. Do not return any array, positional values, nested a/b objects, nulls, extra keys or markdown. This specifies representation only: apply the original rubric unchanged, including negative findings.
